content.value:
Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon.

Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes.

You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.
Details about amiibo™ functionality will arrive at a later date.

fields.text: amiibo sold separately unless otherwise noted. Visit amiibo.com for details on amiibo functionality.

content.value: Samus Aran, one of the greatest bounty hunters in the galaxy. Capable of completing any mission—no matter the danger.

This amiibo figure is larger than standard size. In the Metroid series of games, the Chozo are a highly intelligent, peaceful, and technologically advanced bird-like species. These sentinel statues depicting their likeness offer secrets and powers Samus can use to upgrade her suit.
Included with Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition.
Samus will need to unleash her newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour her enemies, and tap into the overwhelming power of her Metroid Suit, to emerge victorious.
The Metroid Ravenous: Special Edition includes the physical version of the game, a SteelBook® case, and the Samus (Metroid Suit) – Metroid Ravenous Series amiibo figure.
